mapper.insert: insert into dc_point_history (po_no, po_type, po_amount, po_after, po_reason, po_at, po_ex, po_order_no, m_no, ch_no, po_related_no) values ( default, #{poType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{poAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{poAfter, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{poReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{poEx, jdbcType=DATE}, #{poOrderNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{chNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{poRelatedNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: select po_no, po_type, po_amount, po_after, po_reason, po_at, po_ex, po_order_no, m_no, ch_no, po_related_no from dc_point_history where m_no = #{mNo} order by po_at desc, po_no desc

select nvl(sum( greatest( e.po_amount - greatest(u.total_used - (e.cum_earn - e.po_amount), 0), 0 ) ), 0) from ( select po_no, po_amount, po_ex, sum(po_amount) over (order by po_at, po_no rows unbounded preceding) as cum_earn from dc_point_history where m_no = #{mNo} and po_type in ('EARN', 'RESTORE') ) e, ( select nvl(sum(abs(po_amount)), 0) as total_used from dc_point_history where m_no = #{mNo} and po_type in ('USE', 'EXPIRE') ) u where e.po_ex is not null and e.po_ex < sysdate
select distinct m_no from dc_point_history where po_type in ('EARN', 'RESTORE') and po_ex is not null and po_ex < sysdate

select ph.po_no, ph.po_type, ph.po_amount, ph.po_after, ph.po_reason, ph.po_at, ph.po_ex, ph.po_order_no, ph.m_no, ph.ch_no, ph.po_related_no, m.m_id, m.m_name from dc_point_history ph join dc_member m on ph.m_no = m.m_no order by ph.po_at desc, ph.po_no desc
